entities.name: Ion Emanuel Florescu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ioan Emanoil Florescu was a Romanian army general who served as Prime Minister of Romania for a short time in a provisional government in 1876 and then in 1891. He also served as Chief of the General Staff in 1860 and then from 21 April 1864 to 1 May 1866.
